title: Why Sexual Yoga is a Myth: The Truth About Kundalini (1981-03-22)
description:
Can sex or money truly lead to enlightenment? Discover why these modern obsessions block spiritual growth and how to experience the actual awakening of your Kundalini.

Shri Mataji challenges modern misconceptions about spirituality, debunking the role of sex and money in yoga. She explains the true anatomy of the subtle system, the danger of false gurus, and the difference between the 'sacred bone' and the lower centers. Culminates in a live self-realization session.

Key Topics:
• ⚡ The true position of Kundalini in the Sacrum bone vs. the Mooladhara (sex center)
• 💰 Why spiritual awakening is a living process that cannot be bought or sold
• 🧠 Critique of Freud and psychology: Understanding the subconscious and left side
• 🛡️ Warnings against false gurus and 'mantras' that damage the subtle system
• ✨ Live Kundalini awakening - experience the cool breeze of the Holy Ghost

“If sexual manifestation is going to take you to God, animals would be much faster in their evolution than you are. We have nothing to learn from animals. We are human beings.”
— Shri Mataji Nirmala Devi

Audience Questions:
• Are there any dangers in raising the Kundalini?
• Are you going to raise the Kundalini tonight?
• Is the Chaitanya the last avatar of Krishna?

Common Questions About Spiritual Awakening:
• Why you cannot pay for spiritual enlightenment?
• What is the difference between kundalini and sex energy?
• How to identify false gurus and dangerous spiritual practices?

Shri Mataji says we cannot pay for Divine Love just as a flower doesn't pay to bloom. What are your thoughts on the commercialization of modern spirituality?

---

Archival audio recording of H.H. Shri Mataji Nirmala Devi at Sahaja Yoga Public Program 1981 in Maccabean Hall, Darlinghurst (Australia).
